heroHeadline: FARDC-Wazalendo Retake Mahanga and Push on Bitoy as Bukavu School Fire Kills 26 Children and Ebola Tops 3,349 Dead
heroSubtitle: FARDC-Wazalendo forces recaptured Mahanga (Masisi) on Sept 11 and pushed toward AFC/M23 positions at Bitoy on Sept 12, while fighting also resumed at Kibati and Kafunsi in Walikale on Sept 13, paralyzing road traffic. A fire that tore through Cimpunda's Furaha and Ujamaa primary schools in M23-held Bukavu on Sept 10 killed at least 26 children per UNICEF (provincial toll up to 29), prompting accusations that AFC/M23 prioritizes tax collection over civilian protection. An abandoned explosive device killed 7 farmers near Gikoro (Rutshuru) on Sept 12. DRC's Ebola outbreak reached 3,349 deaths among 6,942 cases by the Sept 10 ECDC update and spread Sept 13 to the 70,000-person Savo Plain displacement site in Ituri. Tshisekedi signed an ordinance Sept 13 creating his National Dialogue's Organization Committee, two days ahead of the opposition's planned Sept 15 march.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
